"Schedule a complimentary consultation at your project location for a quote on kitchen equipment, hoods, remodeling, or furnishing." That's from your listing.

So I pulled every Minneapolis kitchen with a city permit open for that exact work. 42 of them. 24 are still under construction or at final inspection — the equipment isn't all bought yet. Most name the contractor.

https://brickandmortar.dev/for/36dc1830/

It's free, no strings. I run a small data shop here in Minneapolis.

Best, Aidan
